title: Who tells consultation that a visit owes nothing?
context: A visit can owe nothing: a zero bill, or the payer covers it. Consultation only hears 'done paying' after a cashier payment or deferral, so these visits never move on.
evidence:
- `backbone/saga/payment.go:212` calls MarkWaiting after payment or deferral only
- lifecycle doc: a zero bill must not stay DRAFT

options.label: Backbone sends a reason with the 'waiting' signal
options.why: One signal path for every case; needs a small backbone follow-up.

options.label: Consultation reads the cashier's live bill

reply: [lane mba/wellmed-188/consult v2gen-one-way1] Option 1: Backbone sends a reason with the 'waiting' signal.
